content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant appears anywhere in the Agreement. The Client covenants article (§ 8) contains only compliance, notification, access-restriction, credit-data licence, representations, and anti-spam covenants; the confidentiality article (§ 10) is limited to Proprietary Information. Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "employ or engage", and "personnel" return no restrictive covenant on either party.

input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching restriction on Client. The Client covenants article (§ 8) is limited to compliance with laws, notification, limitation on access, the Credit Data licence, Client representations and spamming; the confidentiality article (§ 10) addresses only Proprietary Information and Derivative Documentation; and targeted searches for "solicit" (only the unsolicited commercial e-mail policy in § 7), "induce", "recruit", "hire", "employ or engage" and "personnel" return no restrictive covenant binding either party. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is warranted. Note only that the separate Non-Competition Agreement referenced in § 8(d) sits outside this document and was not reviewed here; if it contains personnel covenants, they should be checked against the fallback (mutual, services personnel only, 12 months, general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
